# MP3ToText

> MP3ToText is an AI-powered SaaS tool designed for fast and accurate MP3 audio and video to text transcription.

## Core Features

- **MP3 to Text Conversion**: Transcribe MP3 audio files into clean, readable Markdown or TXT format.
- **Multilingual Support**: Supports high-accuracy transcription in over 90 languages.
- **Speaker Diarization**: Automatically detect and separate different speakers with timestamps.
